title.zh: v2.10.0 六套皮肤走进 PC 与 iPad：色板由手机端生成，桌面端也有各自的气质，设置里可切换
title.en: v2.10.0 The Six Skins on PC and iPad: the Palette Generated From the Phone's, Each Skin's Own Character, and a Picker in Settings

highlights.zh: **皮肤从「手机专属」变成「整个应用」。** 在此之前，六套皮肤只作用于手机外壳（`src/mobile/`，选择器都在 `.mobile-root` 之下），桌面端与 iPad 端只有一套硬编码在 `tailwind.config.js` 里的深色调色板，加上散落在 `src/` 里的约 **1700 处 `bg-[#…]` 字面色值**。现在桌面的色板是**由手机端自己的 token 生成的**：`scripts/desktop_skins.mjs` 直接读 `src/mobile/skins/<id>.css`，把底色、卡片、线条、墨色、强调色以及由它们推导出的悬停/柔和/发光色写进 `src/styles/`（`desktopTokens.css` 是默认皮肤、随首屏；`desktopSkins.css` 是另外五套调色板与字面映射，跟随皮肤懒加载）。`check:skins` 会在手机端色板改动而没重新生成时失败——两个界面因此不可能各说各话。
highlights.en: **The skins stop being the phone's and become the app's.** Until now the six skins applied only to the phone shell (`src/mobile/`, every selector under `.mobile-root`), while the desktop and the iPad had one hardcoded dark palette in `tailwind.config.js` plus ~**1 700 literal `bg-[#…]` values** across `src/`. The desktop palette is now **generated from the phone's own tokens**: `scripts/desktop_skins.mjs` reads `src/mobile/skins/<id>.css` and writes the ground, card, lines,…

highlights.zh: **字面色值按「角色」映射，而不是按颜色。** Tailwind 的命名色（`bg-panel`、`text-accent`…）现在都解析成 `rgb(var(--d-…) / <alpha-value>)`，所以透明度写法照常可用；但源码里那 458 个不同的字面色值编译后的工具类改不了，于是生成器把**每一个**用到的字面色值按**最接近的角色**映射到 token 上（496 条规则只写 token，因此一条规则服务六套皮肤）。另外两类也一并处理：Tailwind **自带调色板**（`from-indigo-500`、`bg-purple-600`、`text-amber-400`）按色相家族映射到语义角色（绿=成功、红=危险、琥珀=警告、靛/紫/青=强调），**中性灰阶**按前缀与深浅映射（深灰填充=面板、浅灰=纸面、灰边框=发丝线、灰字=墨色层级）——后者修掉了一个真实缺陷：挑战页的 A/B/C/D 选项卡是 `bg-neutral-800` + 外壳墨色，在浅色皮肤上曾经是「深底压深字」完全看不见。实测现在三套浅/深皮肤的选项卡对…
highlights.en: **Literals are mapped by *role*, not by colour.** Tailwind's named colours (`bg-panel`, `text-accent`, …) now resolve through `rgb(var(--d-…) / <alpha-value>)`, so opacity utilities keep working; but the 458 distinct literal values in the source compile to utilities a skin cannot reach, so the generator maps **every** literal in use to its **nearest role** (496 rules that name only tokens, so one rule serves all six skins). highlights.zh: **每套皮肤在桌面端也有自己的气质**，不只是换色：`minimal` 是发丝线与 Inter、把桌面所有阴影与渐变整片关掉（用一条 1px 强调描边表达层级）；`soviet` 是冲压钢板（方角、2px 边、上下内阴影的斜面、石碑式大写、按下时 `translate(1px,1px)` 且过渡用 `steps(2,end)`）；`comic` 是新闻纸（Bangers/Patrick Hand、网点与纸纤维用 `background-image` 固定铺在根上、硬墨块取代柔和投影、套印错位的青/品红版条）；`pixel` 是 VT323/Press Start 2P、2px 阶梯边框、扫描线与像素网格、取消所有渐变与模糊；`sovietYears` 是构成主义宣传画（`Russo One` + `skewX(-10deg)` 仅用于展示文字、对角 `clip-path` 切角并配零模糊投影、国旗红压顶线、ПРАВДА 钢印、星形点缀、机械式按压）。**五个文件都只作用在桌面表面**（`[data-surface="desktop"]`）：手机…
highlights.en: **Each skin has its own character on the desktop too**, not just a palette: `minimal` is hairlines and Inter with every shadow and gradient switched off; `soviet` is stamped steel (square corners, 2px edges, an inset bevel, stencilled capitals, a press that travels `translate(1px,1px)` on `steps(2,end)`); `comic` is newsprint (Bangers/Patrick Hand, Ben-Day dots and paper fibre fixed on the root as `background-image`, hard ink blocks instead of soft shadows, cyan/magenta misr…
